name: signed_minimal.k
model:
class SignedIntMinimal {
  val1:Int = 42
  i8:Int8 = val1 as Int8
  back8:Int = i8 as Int

  req back8 = 42
}

main:SignedIntMinimal
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SignedIntMinimal (mk-SignedIntMinimal (val1 Int)(i8 (_ BitVec 8))(back8 Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SignedIntMinimal (sel-SignedIntMinimal SignedIntMinimal))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SignedIntMinimal ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SignedIntMinimal (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SignedIntMinimal ((this Ref)) SignedIntMinimal
  (sel-SignedIntMinimal (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SignedIntMinimal ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SignedIntMinimal this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------------------
;   Getters for class SignedIntMinimal:
; ---------------------------------------

; --- getters for SignedIntMinimal.val1: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal!val1 ((this Ref)) Int
  (val1 (deref-SignedIntMinimal this))
)

; --- getters for SignedIntMinimal.i8: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal!i8 ((this Ref)) (_ BitVec 8)
  (i8 (deref-SignedIntMinimal this))
)

; --- getters for SignedIntMinimal.back8: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal!back8 ((this Ref)) Int
  (back8 (deref-SignedIntMinimal this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SignedIntMinimal (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SignedIntMinimal:
; -----------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SignedIntMinimal SignedIntMinimal)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedIntMinimal!val1 this) 42)
)

(assert (! (SignedIntMinimal.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedIntMinimal!i8 this) ((_ int2bv 8) (SignedIntMinimal!val1 this)))
)

(assert (! (SignedIntMinimal.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedIntMinimal!back8 this) (ite (bvslt (SignedIntMinimal!i8 this) (_ bv0 8)) (- (bv2int (SignedIntMinimal!i8 this)) 256) (bv2int (SignedIntMinimal!i8 this))))
)

(assert (! (SignedIntMinimal.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun SignedIntMinimal.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SignedIntMinimal!back8 this) 42)
)

(assert (! (SignedIntMinimal.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SignedIntMinimal const-1-SignedIntMinimal))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-SignedIntMinimal () SignedIntMinimal
  (mk-SignedIntMinimal 42 #x2a 42))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 ((_ int2bv 8) (val1 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))))))
  (= (i8 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (bvslt (i8 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))) #x00))
      (a!2 (bv2int (i8 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))))))
  (= (back8 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))) (ite a!1 (- a!2 256) a!2))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SignedIntMinimal a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (val1 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))) 42))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (back8 (sel-SignedIntMinimal (select heap 1))) 42))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-SignedIntMinimal (mk-SignedIntMinimal 42 #x2a 42))))
